text:
Maya R: VectorLabs weekly capacity snapshot — GPU hours +18% w/w, pool:vectored saturation peaked 92% last night, avg queue depth 3.6. Sharing quick notes.
capacity-bot: [alert] pool:vectored saturation > 90% (2167890105). spike window 02:10-03:22 UTC. Auto-tagged for ops review.
Priya S: Thanks. I pulled the perf tail — 95th latency jumped to 750ms during spike (baseline ~200ms). Looks like mixed small/long seq workloads caused batching inefficiency.
Luca H: Onboarding update: we pushed the reserved hours bump last Thursday (+40h/week). That change covers daytime but not the overnight burst.
Jordan K: Spend note: VectorLabs' monthly bill is trending +22% due to spike. Renewal health still green but finance asked for a breakdown and mitigation plan.
Maya R: Action items: 1) @Priya investigate kernel/batch config to reduce tail latencies; 2) @Luca confirm if ephemeral burst can be scheduled for the predictable overnight window; 3) Jordan to draft cost breakdown for the customer. Will sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC for 1h.
Priya S: Quick debug query I ran:
```
topk(5, sum_over_time(gpu_hours{tenant="vectorlabs"}[7d]))
```
It shows pool:vectored is top consumer and the long-seq jobs correlate with higher kv-cache hits.
Luca H: I can enable ephemeral burst (2 nodes) for 2 hours next Tue 10:00-12:00 UTC to relieve queue. Need approval for cost impact from Jordan.
Jordan K: Approved for the trial window. I'll include a per-route cost table and note the burst as a one-time experiment in the renewal packet.
Maya R: Good. Priya, if batching config change requires a rollout, run canary on dedicated pool first and monitor tail latencies + error rates.
Priya S: Will do. My hypothesis: reduce max_batch_size for small-seq routes and enable prefix cache for long-seq to avoid mixing. Canary config ready.
capacity-bot: pool:vectored saturation alert cleared (2167890150). No further alerts in last 30m.
Jordan K: Also capture customer feedback: they asked for clearer throttle reasons in Console and a per-route cost toggle. I'll create an enablement doc and loop in docs team.
Maya R: Perfect. I'll send a short recap to VectorLabs after the 10:00 sync and add the burst trial + cost breakdown to the renewal packet. Closing thread unless new flags. :thumbsup:
